description: Answers: what will the wind, gusts, temperature, rain, cloud and other conditions be at a place and time, including wind and gusts at chosen heights above ground, and what were they in past hours the plan includes. Returns hourly values in the user's units, each with its status against the user's thresholds. "Good" means within the user's own UAV Forecast limits, not safe; airspace, permissions, aircraft limits and battery are not included. Current factor keys: wind_at_altitude, max_altitude, temp_or_wind_chill, humidity, delta_t, precip_prob, precip_intensity, thunder_prob, cloud_cover, cloud_base, icing, visibility, sun_elevation, gps, kp, gps_kp, gust_at_altitude; unknown keys may appear. Anything the plan, region or data sources don't include is listed under "unavailable" with a reason (plan, region, source, setting).

altitude_units.description: m or ft; set it whenever the user names a unit.

altitudes.description: Heights above ground (AGL) in altitude_units; without altitude_units, the user's altitude units (see get_my_settings). Each must be above 0: the lowest forecast wind is the surface wind at 10 m (33 ft), so ask for that for wind at ground level.

factors.description: The factors to read; without it, those with an enabled threshold plus wind and gust.

place.description: A favorite location's name, a place name, "lat, lon" coordinates, or "here".

profile.description: A saved settings profile's name, to answer with that profile's settings instead of the current ones.

start.description: Local date or date-time; may be in the past within your plan's historical window.

name: get_hourly_forecast

altitude.description: Height above ground the value applies at.

factor.description: Factor key. Current keys: wind_at_altitude, max_altitude, temp_or_wind_chill, humidity, delta_t, precip_prob, precip_intensity, thunder_prob, cloud_cover, cloud_base, icing, visibility, sun_elevation, gps, kp, gps_kp, gust_at_altitude. Unknown keys may appear.

speed.description: Wind factors: gust or wind, the speed the value is. A wind factor judged by its gusts is reported as its gust factor.

status.description: good, too_low, too_high or in_excluded_band; not_counted when one of the user's app settings keeps the factor out of the verdict; others may appear.

LocalTime.description: Local time at the place, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-11-18T07:15:00+13:00.

reason.description: plan, region, source, setting; others may appear.

Units.description: Display unit per quantity, e.g. {"wind": "km/h", "alt": "m"}. Altitudes are above ground (AGL).

status.description: ok or subscription_required; others may appear.

title: Hourly forecast
